[NH2:6] + Cl[S:9](=O)(=O)[c:12]... => product with N attached to S and Cl removed. So retrosynthetic precursors: an aniline (aryl amine) and aryl sulfonyl chloride.

Thus we need to apply template 733 to the target molecule (the product). The target molecule is likely the same as in previous step: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1". Let's apply template to that SMILES.
